correctness.rationale: Fix 0<a<1. Exact independent symbolic matrix multiplication confirms tr(B³A³)-2=(ab−1)[(a²−2)b²−ab+4−2a²] and the endpoint reduction mod Q(b). Q strictly decreases in b>=0, has unique b_*(a)∈(1,sqrt2), with ab_*<1 and positive trace derivative d(a). At b_* the target continuant H_m=(A² C^m)12 equals −mc(a)−a with c>0; at trace t=2cos(pi/m) a lower b yields H_m=a>0, giving an elliptic root θ∈(0,pi/m). The sine interpolation of C^j v_0 between endpoints gives nonnegative coefficients multiplying two vectors whose six pre-step signs both implement a³b³ for 0<a<1<b; hence root is dynamically legal, and published Theorem 18 supplies uniqueness. The tan phase equation near θ=0 gives pi−mθ=κθ+O_a(θ³) and hence b_*−b_m=pi²/[d(m+κ)²]+O_a(m^−4). Independently evaluated a=0.5 for m=30,75,150,300: b_*-b_m decreases 0.0028520614,0.0006811872,0.0002017946,0.0000553710 and corrected residual drops from 1.57e−4 to 7.06e−9. Numerical examples corroborate, do not establish the fixed-a asymptotic.
